jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Working StudentStellenbeschreibung:Company DescriptionContinental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 76,000 people in 54 countries and markets.Tire solutions from the Tires group sector make mobility safer, smarter, and more sustainable. Its premium portfolio encompasses car, truck, bus, two-wheel, and specialty tires as well as smart solutions and services for fleets and tire retailers. Continental has been delivering top performance for more than 150 years and is one of the world’s largest tire manufacturers. In fiscal 2025, the Tires group sector generated sales of 13.8 billion euros. Continental's tire division currently employs around 53,000 people worldwide and has 19 production and 16 development sites.Job DescriptionJoin us in shaping the future of Production and Industrial EngineeringAt our Industrial Engineering department in Hannover-Stöcken, we create sustainable value by driving efficiency, organizational and digital transformation in Production. Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and food service platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to consultation, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions with a targeted deal close of mid-2027. Public Affairs & Reputation Manager Germany (d/f/m)ABOUT THE JOBYou will lead the Corporate Affairs agenda in Germany, protecting and enhancing the reputation of the business through public affairs, trade association work, stakeholder engagement and issues management. You will help the business grow and move through its transformation by making sure policymakers, industry bodies, media and other key stakeholders understand our positions on the food topics that matter most, from nutrition to packaging.You will be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters. Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Develop and implement the German Corporate Affairs strategy for Foods, aligned to business priorities and the global Corporate Affairs direction. - Partner with the German Foods leadership team to spot external risks and opportunities early, so that Corporate Affairs shapes business decisions from the start. - With support from European Corporate Affairs, build and maintain relationships with policymakers, trade associations, media, and other key stakeholders. Represent Foods in relevant forums and committees and advance our advocacy on priority issues such as supply chain fairness, nutrition and reformulation, sustainability and packaging, innovation and responsible marketing. - Monitor political, regulatory and stakeholder developments and assess implications for Foods and its reputation. - Lead local issues management, crisis preparedness and reputation protection, so that emerging risks are identified and managed effectively. - Be a trusted advisor to business leaders on stakeholder engagement, communications and external positioning. - With support from Global Media Relations, manage media enquiries with timely, accurate and aligned responses that protect and strengthen Foods' reputation. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Significant experience (typically 7+ years) in corporate affairs, public affairs or communications, gained in a company, trade association, agency, political office or newsroom. - Strong understanding of the German political, policy, regulatory and trade association landscape, ideally with experience in food, nutrition, consumer or sustainability issues. - Proven ability to represent business positions externally and work through trade associations to shape credible, evidence-based policy engagement. - Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and relationship-building skills, with with the ability to build strong external networks. - Excellent written and spoken German and English, with strong presentation and writing skills. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience managing reputation, stakeholder engagement and communications within a complex organization; experience working through business transformation is a plus. - Calm, sound judgement under pressure and on sensitive issues. - Confidence with digital tools, including AI-supported monitoring and content, used responsibly.  WHAT WE OFFER YOU:- flexible hours and the option for remote work- 30 days of vacation plus December 24th and 31st off- Meal allowance: €65 per month- Access to Manager Check‑Ups – Optional executive‑level health screenings to support long‑term well‑being and performance- Company pension & shares- In-house café: snacks, lunch, and coffee specialties at discounted prices- ·Discounts via Corporate Benefits- Deutschland Ticket: €50 monthly subsidy or a discounted company bike- Free training opportunities and access to our own learning platform- E-GYM/Wellpass for €20 per month & free corporate health management & a 24/7 counseling service- And the best for last – unlimited ice cream!ARE YOU INTERESTED?Great! We look forward to receiving your application online. Please note that applications submitted by email cannot be considered.Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.

release- Apply laboratory best practices regarding safety, usability, standardization, traceability, documentation, and continuous improvement- Create and maintain manuals, working instructions, risk training, FMEA, and the standardization of test processesWhat you will need- A degree in electronical engineering or a comparable technical discipline- Relevant experience in test engineering, electronics development, automation, or a similar technical environment- A strong hands-on mentality and the motivation to build, wire, commission, measure, troubleshoot, and improve technical systems- Good knowledge of electronic circuits, measurement technology, laboratory equipment, and systematic fault analysis- Practical experience with oscilloscopes, data-acquisition systems, programmable power supplies, function generators, or similar laboratory instruments- The ability to understand complete systems across hardware, firmware, communication, and software- Experience in reading, creating, or modifying electronic schematics- Basic programming knowledge and the willingness to work with existing firmware, software, and automated test applications- A structured and analytical working style with a strong quality, safety, and documentation mindset- Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to independently drive technical work packages- German/English spoken and writtenWhat would be an advantage- Knowledge of discrete power semiconductors, particularly SiC MOSFETs- Experience with qualification or reliability tests such as HTRB, H3TRB, PCT, DGS, IOL, TDDB, or thermal-resistance measurements- Experience with KiCad, Altium Designer, or comparable electronic design tools- Programming knowledge in Python, C/C++, LabVIEW, Visual Basic, or MATLAB- Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, communication protocols, instrument control, or automated measurement systems- Familiarity with AEC-Q101, AQG 324, relevant JEDEC jobs.occupation: Senior Quality Engineer / all genders / Part-Fulltime (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Everything we do in Electronics is to help us deliver on our purpose of being the company behind the companies, advancing digital living. We are dedicated to being the trusted supplier of high-tech materials, services and specialty chemicals for the electronics, automotive and cosmetics industries. We foster a global collaborative organization made up of individuals who have the passion to win, obsess about the customer, are relentlessly curious and act with urgency. Together, we push the boundaries of science to make more possible for our customers.Your roleHelp bring next-generation formulation materials to scale by building quality and reliability into products and processes from development through high-volume manufacturing. You’ll work hands-on with R&D, process scale-up, QC, supply chain, facilities, and manufacturing teams to identify customer and process risks early in new product introduction. You’ll guide risk mitigation, change control, and continuous improvement so products and processes are ready for reliable commercialization and sustained performance. You’ll ensure disciplined analytics and effective process controls are in place to monitor product and process health. As a voice of the customer, you’ll help cross-functional teams resolve issues quickly, assess deviations rigorously, and minimize customer impact. You’ll lead structured problem solving and effective corrective and preventive actions, while helping teams identify abnormal events and sources of variation. You’ll strengthen a proactive quality culture, contribute to site audits, and champion improvements that keep pace with semiconductor customers’ needs. You’ll collaborate across sites and time zones, with travel to global manufacturing locations and, when needed, customer sites.Who you are- You have a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or another technical discipline.- You bring at least eight years of experience in chemical manufacturing, process or control engineering, analytical chemistry, and/or semiconductor fabrication.- You communicate excellently in written and spoken English.- You have a safety- and quality-focused approach to process controls, risk assessment, and reducing variation; semiconductor industry experience, particularly in fab process engineering, is an advantage.- You have working knowledge of SPC and statistical methods such as t-tests, ANOVA, and univariate or multivariate modeling.- You have experience with quality and problem-solving methods such as 5 Whys, segmentation, model-based problem solving, FMEAs, CAPA, change management, continuous improvement, and document control.- You are comfortable with data and process-improvement tools such as JMP, Palantir Foundry, Tableau, Python, JSL, or SAP; experience with data automation, digitization, and ISO 9001 quality systems is valued.- You build strong cross-functional relationships, motivate others, and stay organized, attentive to detail, and resilient through ambiguity; auditor or Six Sigma certification and additional languages are a plus.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
